title: Hardship Assistance Programs: One Open Plan per Loan
content:
**Rule.** Hardship assistance under the Hardship Assistance Programs is arranged per loan. A borrower may have open plans (requested, offered or active) on at most 2 loans at the same time, which is every personal loan the borrower can hold. No other hardship plan on the same loan is in requested, offered or active status. A borrower who wants a different program on the same loan first cancels the open request or plan; requests are never stacked on one loan.

## What the rule turns on

| Point | Basis |
|---|---|
| Unit of assistance | one loan |
| Open plan | a plan in requested, offered or active status |
| Loans with open plans at one time | at most 2 per borrower |
| Open plans on one loan | one; a new request is taken only when no other hardship plan on the same loan is requested, offered or active |
| Evidence | the company's own record of the hardship plans on that loan and their statuses, matched by the loan the new request concerns |

The condition is judged on the system record of plans on the same loan, before the request is taken; a plan on the borrower's other loan does not occupy this loan.

## Hypothetical cases

- A loan whose only earlier plan is completed, declined, expired, broken or cancelled has no open plan, and a new request on it is not blocked by this rule.
- A loan with an offered plan has an open plan; a request for a different program on the same loan is not stacked on it.
- A borrower with an active plan on one loan and a requested plan on a second loan has open plans on 2 loans, which this rule allows.
